mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when framing a partition wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risks are framing out of plumb, missing a joist or blocking, and discovering utilities after the wall is opened. Those issues can cause crooked drywall, rework, and extra cost, especially in older homes or remodels.
acceptedAnswer.description: Crooked framing, missed structural attachment points, and hidden plumbing or electrical are the main problems. Careful layout and inspection reduce costly rework.
